claims.evidence: Witness report confirms a white truck with an orange borehole drilling rig mounted on the rear.
The witness noted that the operational status of the rig and hydraulic systems was not shown.
The witness observed wear and scuffing on the front bumper and cab, which may contradict a 'sharp' aesthetic condition.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system failure or leaks in the drilling rig
risks.proof: A video clip showing the mast being raised to a vertical position and the drill head rotating.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional rig requiring hydraulic overhaul

risks.risk: Engine or transmission failure in the Nissan Diesel truck
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting from cold and the truck moving through gears.

risks.risk: Worn out or missing drilling bits and rods
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drill bits and the full inventory of rods on the rack.

risks.risk: High mileage or poor maintenance of the carrier vehicle
risks.proof: Photo of the odometer and the engine maintenance logs.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage vehicle near end-of-life

proof_requests: Video of the drilling rig mast operating and the drill string rotating.
Video of the truck engine running and the vehicle driving.
Photo of the truck's odometer and dashboard while the engine is running.
Close-up photos of the hydraulic pumps and control valves.
Photos of the drilling bits and the interior of the cab.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the asset as a Nissan Diesel UD 6x4 truck with a mounted drilling rig, which allows for a baseline valuation at its worst-case mechanical state.
